people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
translations.bsb: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
translations.kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
translations.asv: holding forth the word of life; that I may have whereof to glory in the day of Christ, that I did not run in vain neither labor in vain.
